name: Haluk Levent
description:
'''Haluk Levent''' (born '''Haluk Acil'''; 26 November 1968) is a Turkish rock singer who helped revive the long forgotten [[Anatolian rock]] genre in the 1990s.

In 2023, Levent was listed as one of ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' magazine's [[Time 100|100 Most Influential People in the World]]. He later said he would not attend the gala due to the criticism aimed at the [[Turkish government]] in the entry penned by [[Elif Shafak]].

Levent was voted Türkiye's most trusted celebrity for 7 consecutive years from 2019 to 2025, breaking records for the index.

In July 2026, he was detained on charges of alleged money laundering and multi-million-dollar fraud.
